# Oneil Anderson

### Data Analyst — Compliance Analytics, Financial Crimes, R + Power BI

I build data pipelines and reporting infrastructure for regulatory
compliance: SQL/Snowflake data models, Power BI dashboards, Power Automate
workflows, and R-based analysis, with a focus on beneficial ownership
disclosure, AML/transaction monitoring, and audit-ready reconciliation
logic.

Every project on this site is built on public or synthetic data —
nothing here reflects any employer's internal systems, data, or policies.
See [About](about.qmd) for more on that boundary.
